confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge; no live listings, menus or booking pages were inspected. Reykjavik is generally pricier than the supplied Western European comparables, so anchors were scaled up from Vienna and Berlin, with Bucharest used only as a floor. Dining and beer are moderately reliable; lodging is least certain, especially July peak-season rates. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct knowledge of those prices is weak. The FX value of 0.6955 for 2026-10-15 was reported in web-search results citing the RBA exchange-rates page, but those results flagged a date-stamp inconsistency on that page, so it is not independently confirmed. The RBA homepage reported 0.7002 for 2026-10-14.
comparable_city_reasoning: Scaled from Vienna and Berlin, the closest supplied Western European comparables, with a Reykjavik premium for dining, drinks and lodging given Iceland's import-heavy cost base and high July demand. Bucharest is far lower and was used only as a floor reference.
